record.notes: Draft v1.1 was released on 25 Jan 2026 and Draft v2.0 on 9 Feb 2026; online public consultation ran from 26 Jan to 8 Feb 2026, and the policy committee was then reviewing the submissions. It replaces the April 2024 draft National AI Policy of the previous government, which was never adopted. The Independent Oversight Committee is to sit within the executive council of a proposed NDGIA body that would itself require legislation. Drafted under the interim government with a National AI Policy Steering Committee formed in July 2025.

judgment.status_reasoning: Not settled by any stored file. The published status 'Draft / proposed' is left as it is. Press reports of July 2026 (lead below) say the government is still formulating a national AI policy, which agrees with no policy having been adopted, but they do not say whether Draft v2.0 remains the basis.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A draft national AI policy whose core is risk-tiered governance, prohibited practices and oversight; in scope with no note.

leads.title: Bangladesh national AI policy being formulated under the government of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman (ICT Minister Faqir Mahbub Anam at WAIC 2026, 18 July 2026)
leads.note: Press reports (UNB, The Business Standard, Financial Express) of a ministry press release: the government is formulating a 'human-centric', integrated and inclusive National AI Policy and drafting guidelines for AI in the public sector. Possibly a successor to the interim government's Draft v2.0 (BD-01); a refresh request for BD-01 rather than a new record until an official text appears.
